ValidationRule.description: CHecks cases pending approvan cannot be changed to other status than REJECTED or CONSIDERATION
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: IsClaim__c && NOT(ISBLANK( ApprovalRequested__c )) && not(Approved__c) && NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Consideration')) && NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Rejected'))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The claim must be approved before the status can be changed
